name: Farrer Park South
summary: South of Farrer Park MRT toward Race Course / Mustafa gravity — NEL mid-town living with hospital-adjacent density and shopping spill as the lifestyle tax.
body: Farrer Park South is the shortlist when North-East Line mid-town access and walkable errands matter more than quiet cul-de-sac living. The pocket sits south of Farrer Park station toward Race Course Road / Mustafa gravity; housing mixes mid-age condos with selective walk-ups. Expats land here for car-light CBD hops and dense retail. Watch-outs: shopping-day crowds, hospital traffic peaks, and corridor hydrant clearance culture on older landings. Compare with Jalan Besar Fringe for food-spine energy, Bendemeer West for quieter NEL edges, and Little India core when heritage density wins.
bestFor: renters comparing Farrer Park vs Little India edges
watchOuts: Keep landing hose reels clear on older blocks
housingMix: Mid-age condos and walk-ups with selective serviced edges.
commuteNotes: North-East Line at Farrer Park; Little India / Rochor adjacency depending on block. Walk a Sunday afternoon before you LOI.
